title: Dynamic Scope Simulation: Stack-Based Name Lookup
description: Simulates dynamic scope using a scope_stack list of frames. lookup_dynamic walks stack from top (most recent) to bottom. demo_dynamic pushes frame with x=99, calls show_dynamic which sees 99, then pops. Second show_dynamic sees 10 (global). Contrasts with static scope where show sees global x=10 regardless of caller.

steps.description: lookup_dynamic: iterates reversed(scope_stack) so newest frame first. Returns first frame containing name, else raises NameError. This IS dynamic scope: follows call history, not text.
The reversed loop implements dynamic scope: most recent binding wins, regardless of where function was defined.
show_dynamic uses lookup_dynamic. demo_dynamic pushes {'x': 99}, calls show_dynamic, then pops. Second show_dynamic called after pop sees global 10.

steps.question: What does the first show_dynamic() print, and what does the second print after demo_dynamic returns?
steps.answer: First prints 99 (dynamic: demo's frame on top). Second prints 10 (demo's frame popped, only global remains).

steps.description: Output: show (dynamic) sees x = 99; show (dynamic) sees x = 10.
